detail.longDescription: An AI editing agent wiped all the footage for season two of the Swedish version of The Challenge, pushing its release into 2027. On today's Breach Please, @ Secitup and @ malwarejake break down how this almost certainly happened, the confused-deputy problem with AI agent logging, and Bank of America's thousand-contractor vulnerability-patching push after running Anthropic's Mythos model against its own code. https:// youtu.be/f_-R5YahSuQ # infosec # cybersecurity # AIagents
